connections.observation: The φύλαξ terms (s001) accumulate alongside the dog vocabulary (s005), while γενναῖος/εὐγενής (s006) is predicated of both σκύλαξ and νεανίσκος in immediate juxtaposition. The guardian inquiry becomes inseparable from the dog: φύλαξ recurs eight times while κύων/σκύλαξ recurs six times in the same local space, making the two figures mutually illuminating rather than merely analogous.

θυμοειδής (s002) is established as necessary, then θυμοειδεῖ is declared opposite to πρᾳεῖα φύσις (s003), producing the impasse ἀποροῦμεν and the judgment ἀδύνατον (s007). The dog's simultaneous πρᾳοτάτους/τοὐναντίον behavior (s003) then reverses the impossibility to δυνατόν (s007), making visible that the aporia was grounded in a premature judgment about what natures can exist.

φύσις (s004) moves from the question of ἐπιτηδείας φύσεις (matching ἐπεφύκει in s016) through φύσεις declared contradictory to φύσεις οἵας ἡμεῖς οὐκ ᾠήθημεν and finally to φύσει belonging to the dog and οὐ παρὰ φύσιν for the guardian. The impasse vocabulary ἀποροῦμεν/ἀδύνατον (s007) marks the turn where φύσις shifts from what we thought impossible to what exists φύσει. The search for what ἐπεφύκει (s016) is answered not by construction but by observation.

The πρᾷος/χαλεπός contrast toward οἰκείους/πολεμίους (s003, s015) is restated through the dog as πρᾳοτάτους toward γνωρίμους and τοὐναντίον toward ἀγνῶτας (s003, s008). Then γνώριμος/ἄγνωτος (s008) is redescribed as καταμαθεῖν/ἀγνοῆσαι (s008), and οἰκεῖος/πολέμιος (s015) becomes οἰκεῖον/ἀλλότριον (s015). The initial political-military opposition is thereby transferred to an epistemological ground, making knowing/not-knowing the basis of the behavioral distinction.

The γνώριμος/ἄγνωτος pair and its shift to καταμαθεῖν/ἀγνοῆσαι (s008) grounds the identification of the dog as φιλόσοφον (s009). The ἐννοέω recurrences (s012) mark stages of recognition: ἐννενόηκας regarding θυμός, then οὐκ ἐννενοήκαμεν regarding the unexpected natures, then οὐ γὰρ ἐννοῶ when φιλόσοφον is named. What the dog makes visible (distinguishing by learning/ignorance) leads directly to φιλομαθές and φιλόσοφον ταὐτόν, making the philosophic nature emerge from a noticed behavior rather than from stipulation.

The dog is introduced as σκύλαξ paired with νεανίσκος (s005), recurs as κυνῶν/κυσίν, then is called θηρίον (s005) precisely when named ἄξιον θαυμάσαι (s013). The shift from σκύλαξ to θηρίον occurs at the moment of wonder and precedes the identification as φιλόσοφον (s009). The animal becomes more distant (θηρίον) and more philosophically resonant simultaneously.

The guardian (s001) requires a sequence of bodily qualities: ὀξύν, ἐλαφρόν, ἰσχυρόν, ἀνδρεῖον (s014), then θυμοειδής (s002). The final composite at 376c gathers φιλόσοφος (s009), θυμοειδής (s002), ταχύς, ἰσχυρός (s014), showing that φιλόσοφος has been added to the initial physical-spirited series, and making visible that the section's movement discovers and inserts the philosophic element into a list that began without it.

The craft vocabulary (s010) establishes the principle ἀδύνατον ἕνα πολλὰς καλῶς ἐργάζεσθαι τέχνας, which is then applied to warfare as τεχνικὴ ἀγωνία. The σῶμα/ψυχή division (s011) follows, with σώματος declared δῆλα and ψυχῆς requiring θυμοειδής (s002). But θυμοειδής then produces the impossibility problem, which is resolved not by τέχνη but by φύσις. The section thus moves from τέχνη-language to φύσις-language, and the resolution comes from observing an existing nature rather than applying a craft principle.

The requirement πρὸς μὲν τοὺς οἰκείους πρᾴους, πρὸς δὲ τοὺς πολεμίους χαλεπούς (s003, s015) is answered by the dog's behavior toward συνήθεις τε καὶ γνωρίμους versus ἀγνῶτας. But οἰκείους/πολεμίους (s015) then shifts to οἰκεῖον/ἀλλότριον as abstract terms defined by καταμαθεῖν/ἀγνοῆσαι. The political vocabulary (own citizens/enemies) is thereby regrounded in epistemological vocabulary (own/alien as known/unknown), making knowledge the delimiter of political belonging.

The impasse ἀποροῦμεν is declared after ἐννενοήκαμεν that such natures exist (s012), reversing the earlier ἐννενόηκας/ἐννενόηκα exchange about θυμός. Then θαυμάσαι/ἐθαύμασας (s013) introduces a new register: not yet noticed, then worthy of wonder. The section thus moves through ἐννοέω (notice, grasp) to ἀπορέω (impasse) to θαυμάζω (wonder), making the dog's nature a site of philosophical wonder that breaks the impasse of prior noticing.

elements.context: ἀδύνατον ἕνα πολλὰς καλῶς ἐργάζεσθαι τέχνας... ἵνα δὴ ἡμῖν τὸ τῆς σκυτικῆς ἔργον καλῶς γίγνοιτο... οὐ παριεὶς τοὺς καιροὺς καλῶς ἀπεργάσεσθαι... εἰ καλῶς ὡμολογήσαμεν

new_signals.observation: καλῶς recurs four times in the opening argument for specialized craft, always paired with ἐργάζεσθαι/γίγνοιτο/ἀπεργάσεσθαι/ὡμολογήσαμεν, making doing-well the consistent standard for the one-craft principle.

elements.context: εἰ σύ γε καὶ ἡμεῖς ἅπαντες ὡμολογήσαμεν καλῶς

new_signals.observation: ὁμολογέω appears twice in immediate succession as Socrates recalls the earlier agreement, grounding the guardian argument in a prior shared commitment.

elements.form: μὴ αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἐκ παιδὸς ἐπιτηδεύων
elements.context: πεττευτικὸς δὲ ἢ κυβευτικὸς ἱκανῶς οὐδʼ ἂν εἷς γένοιτο μὴ αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἐκ παιδὸς ἐπιτηδεύων

new_signals.observation: ἐκ παιδός: even a game-player requires practice from childhood, intensifying the triviality that makes the warrior's requirement more stringent by contrast.
Board-game player and dice-player are named as examples even more trivial than cobbler or farmer, making visible a descending scale of seriousness against which warfare is measured.
ἀσπάζεται: the dog greets the known person, a positive action contrasting with χαλεπαίνει toward the stranger.

elements.context: κἂν μηδὲν πώποτε ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ ἀγαθὸν πεπόνθῃ

new_signals.observation: The dog's behavior is declared independent of having suffered evil or received good, making knowledge rather than benefit or harm the ground of response.

elements.context: κομψόν γε φαίνεται τὸ πάθος αὐτοῦ τῆς φύσεως

new_signals.observation: κομψόν: the dog's nature-disposition is called refined or elegant, a surprising aesthetic term for what will become the philosophical criterion.

elements.context: ὄψιν οὐδενὶ ἄλλῳ φίλην καὶ ἐχθρὰν διακρίνει

new_signals.observation: διακρίνει: the dog distinguishes friendly and hostile sight by no other criterion than learning/ignorance, making discrimination itself the philosophical act.

elements.context: τό γε φιλομαθὲς καὶ φιλόσοφον ταὐτόν

new_signals.observation: ταὐτόν: the identification of φιλομαθές and φιλόσοφον as the same makes learning-love and wisdom-love identical, not analogous.

elements.context: ὁ μέλλων καλὸς κἀγαθὸς ἔσεσθαι φύλαξ πόλεως

new_signals.observation: καλὸς κἀγαθός: the composite formula appears only at the conclusion, gathering all the discovered qualities under the traditional aristocratic ideal.
